name: Algo Four XL
notes: DX100 panel; one OP picker selects all fourteen operator controls. POLY/MONO is voice count (8/1): Selectors cannot set it. LFO SPEED is 0.02–40 Hz, not 0.0008–55; its range control is hidden. D2R zero cannot hold D1L from this card (linked level hidden). PB MODE selects LOW/HIGH/KON. Breath uses CC 2; foot uses CC 64. Ratio uses semitones, detune cents, bend octaves. Cartridge, MIDI settings and stored patch memory are hardware/storage, not reproduced.
